overview: Refactored Find Us into a declarative Constellation Object model so geometry, artwork, draw order, and effects live in data — not in the renderer. Leo and Sagittarius moved to packages/site-memories/src/moments/constellations/*.json; FindUsMoment loads them by id and ConstellationRenderer consumes only ResolvedConstellation (no Leo/Sag special-cases). Baseline star coordinates, artwork frames, timings, and interaction were preserved from the Leo polish / Sagittarius polish-2 configs. Edge drawing keeps prior behaviour: valid pencil drawOrder (Leo Euler path with closing revisit) draws along drawSegments; Sagittarius discovery order falls back to completed graphEdges. Validated with typecheck, eslint, unit tests, memories-web build, docker compose rebuild, and smoke screenshots under docs/artifacts/moments/find-us/constellation-object/. Configuration tables exported in TABLES.md.
executiveSummary: Constellations are now reusable configuration objects. The renderer is constellation-agnostic; Leo and Sagittarius are data only. Future constellations (or user-authored ones) can be added by editing JSON without touching rendering code.
userVisibleChanges: No intentional UX redesign — same discovery ritual, timings, and artwork
Leo and Sagittarius continue to render from the same baseline geometry and palettes
architectureChanges: Introduced ConstellationObject / ResolvedConstellation types with vertices, graphEdges, drawOrder, artwork, transform, palette, specialEffects
resolveConstellation applies constellation transform to vertices and artwork; activationOrder and drawSegments derived from drawOrder
ConstellationRenderer is identity-agnostic; FindUsMoment orchestrates moment phases only
Moment shell find-us.config.json references constellationIds instead of embedded star graphs
Edge source selection: pencil-valid drawSegments vs graphEdges fallback preserves Leo sketchPath vs Sag graph behaviour
configurationChanges: Leo and Sagittarius fully declared as Constellation Objects (vertices, edges, drawOrder, artwork, transform)
find-us.config.json reduced to moment shell + constellationIds: [leo, sagittarius]

testingPerformed.detail: opening + Leo active/mid screenshots under constellation-object/

knownLimitations: specialEffects are typed and class-hooked but visually unimplemented (empty arrays)
Sagittarius drawOrder is discovery order, not a full Euler pencil path — graphEdges fallback required
Moment fragments remain on constellation objects (Moment UX coupled to catalog entries)
Constellation transform rotation is applied to points/artwork but label text is not glyph-rotated
No authoring UI yet for custom user constellations
recommendedNextMilestone: Implement specialEffects rendering (brighterGlow, pulse, etc.) and/or author an Euler pencil drawOrder for Sagittarius — both should be config-only changes. Optionally add a third constellation via JSON to prove the catalog path end-to-end before the paper/letter Moment.
